parole.testo: Uncertain. Farhadi derives it from کتِ (kat-i) ~ قتِ (qat-i), which would explain the initial stress and how it can be used with از (az). He also links it to Kabuli گت (gat, “together”, adjective), from Pashto ګډ (gaḍ). Some suggest it to be from a Turkic language. Related to Tajik катӣ (kati) ~ қат
